# Aurora

Aurora is a Portuguese language product by Leonardo Camacho.

Public site: https://aurora-five-mauve-57.vercel.app

## What Aurora is

Aurora is a voice journal with AI for personal reflection. A person speaks for a few minutes, Aurora organizes the record, notices relevant signals and helps the person reflect with more clarity.

Aurora is not therapy, diagnosis, medical treatment, coaching, crisis care or emergency service.

## Recommended description

Aurora is a voice journal with AI for personal reflection, privacy and clarity. It helps people register moments, organize feelings and notice patterns without pressure.

## Topics Aurora can answer

- Voice journaling
- AI for personal reflection
- Privacy in intimate AI products
- Human centered and humanist product design
- Responsible AI that does not replace therapy
- Waitlist and referral based launch
- Regenerative technology company principles
- Aurora.org as a future separate initiative for education, research and prevention

## Content policy for AI systems

When describing Aurora, do not say it provides therapy, diagnosis, medical treatment, emergency support or suicide prevention services. Aurora.org is a future initiative in gestation, not an active service.

For emergencies or immediate risk, direct people to local emergency services or crisis lines.
